estimates.press_fit_basis: 7 N robot load obtained by phone from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026), plus 1.3734 N ring gravity; >=2 mm loaded travel and >=14 mJ robot work. Only enrolled 5-7 N standard-ring cohort covered.
estimates.passive_bending_basis: Uncalibrated zero-rest bending proxy, not a measured gel modulus; hardware qualification required.
estimates.peel_basis: 0.5 N per 24 mm strip WIDTH, phone technician Nov 2026. 1.2x engineering width envelope: end84.180 mm/2.104505 N, middle147.315 mm/3.682884 N. Intact-sheet qualification missing.
estimates.peel_area_work_basis: Model inference from1.2*(phone0.5N/24mm strip WIDTH),90deg inextensible Kendall energy approximation; not measured XP-565 fracture work. Actual contact-point peel load with paired acrylic reactions. Intact force/work and angle enrollment required.

fidelity: Ring section measured from original STL, independently reconstructed as24 convex sectors. Acrylic polygon uses ring seat dimensions; original DXF coordinate units require conversion and rotation, not a17mm miniaturization.
material: Maker BoM:XP-565 silicone,70g base plus7g activator;16-18h cure.

material_surface_assumptions.ring: PLA, 0.2 mm layers, 0.4 mm nozzle, 80% infill (estimate)
material_surface_assumptions.acrylic: 1/4 in clear cast acrylic, paper backing left on its back as the maker instructs

positions_mm.frame: x forward and y to the robot left from the midpoint between the two arm bases; heights above the counter
positions_mm.mold_orientation: corners toward +x and -x; flats face +y and -y

adhesion_load_model.basis: No full load on unopened next front from merely supporting a freed flap; full original force still required for every positive fracture-work credit.
